themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and execute actions within a research context.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a wide range of AI-powered tools and platforms specifically designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, acting as intelligent programming partners.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, recruitment, and the overall structure of the human workforce.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to analyze and understand user sentiment, reviews, and feedback to inform product and service improvements.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles exploring the use, capabilities, and impact of AI chatbots in research, including their interactions and user experiences.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers AI applications in the design process, from ideation and prototyping to user interface generation and visual asset creation.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Highlights AI tools and techniques for analyzing large datasets, extracting insights, and identifying patterns for research and product development.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Explores how AI can assist product managers in areas like ideation, feature prioritization, market analysis, and user understanding.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial user profiles or personas for testing, training, or simulating user behavior.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
